source.how: Ayaka's engine (LLM.generate) on an NVIDIA L4, flashinfer attention, CUDA graphs, bf16, greedy, at commit 0019762 plus the Qwen3 model of the same pull request. Prompt token ids rendered by transformers apply_chat_template with the checkpoint's own template, the tools get_weather and get_time when tools_in_prompt is true, and enable_thinking as listed.

fields.raw: decoded with special tokens kept (ends with <|im_end|>)
fields.text: special tokens dropped: what the parser sees; <think>, </think>, <tool_call> and </tool_call> are added tokens that are not special, so they stay
fields.marker_ids_in_output: which of the four marker ids the generated token ids contain: each marker was one token
